The method of online application will be provided in the detailed advertisement, which the Mandal will upload separately.
Visit the official website of the Mandal, https://cgssb.cgstate.gov.in.
Read the detailed advertisement once it is uploaded, including the post-wise rules, conditions and syllabus.
Apply online as per the method described in the detailed advertisement.

rows.answer_from_the_notice: 12 post categories under Group-2 Class III (Postgraduate and Graduate level) Sub Group-02, including Assistant Grade 3, Data Entry Operator, Steno Typist and Assistant Sub Inspector-A
